sources.entry: Oni - Oni is a modern take on modal editing code editor focused on developer productivity.

summary.one_liner: Oni is a cross-platform code editor that combines Neovim's modal editing with IDE-style features, and the README says the project is now unmaintained.
summary.what_it_does: Oni is a graphical editor built on Neovim that adds IDE-like features to Vim-style modal editing. The README lists an embedded browser, quick info, code completion, syntax and compilation error display, fuzzy finding, a status bar, and an interactive tutorial. It says it runs on Windows, Mac, and Linux. Plugins are written in JavaScript rather than VimL. Windows and macOS builds bundle a version of Neovim. The README says the project is unmaintained and the maintainers are focusing on Onivim 2 and libvim.
use_cases: Vim-style code editing with IDE features
Writing code with completion and error highlighting
Fuzzy finding files in a code project
Learning Vim with an interactive tutorial
Extending a Neovim-based editor with JavaScript plugins
how_to_run: Download the latest binaries from the Releases page
Follow the platform installation guide for Windows, Mac, or Linux
To build from source, follow the Development guide in the wiki
notable: Built on Neovim with a graphical front end
Plugins written in JavaScript instead of VimL
Embedded browser and quick info inside the editor
Bundles Neovim on Windows and macOS
caveats: The README says the repository is unmaintained
The maintainers are focusing on Onivim 2 and libvim instead
Windows and macOS builds bundle Neovim; Linux setup is not described in the README
